def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Each closed zero region is recolored according to the unique marker color inside it.
    from collections import deque
    seen=set(); result=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       if g[r][c]!=0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
       q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]; edge=False
       while q:
        y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
        if y in (0,h-1) or x in (0,w-1): edge=True
        for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
         if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and g[yy][xx]==0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
          seen.add((yy,xx));q.append((yy,xx))
       if not edge:
        marks={g[y][x] for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if g[y][x] not in (0,2) and (y,x) in cells}
        color=8 if 2 in {g[y][x] for y,x in cells} else 4
        for y,x in cells: result[y][x]=color
    return result
PY
